## Security note

If this is a security vulnerability rather than a functional bug, **do not** file it here --
see [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/Fynora/finora/blob/main/SECURITY.md) for private reporting
instead. (An absolute link, deliberately -- issue-template bodies render inside GitHub's "new
issue" form, not as a normal file view, and a repo-relative link's resolution there isn't
something this session verified against the live UI.)
